subject: Money
title: Tariffs and Trade Tax
description: Learn Tariffs and Trade Tax in one minute.

hook.text: In 1930, the U.S. raised tariffs on 20,000 goods. World trade collapsed 65% in four years.

buildup.text: Tariffs are taxes on imported goods. They make foreign products more expensive to protect local industry.

discovery.text: The importer pays the tariff, not the foreign company. Costs get passed to domestic consumers.

twist.text: Tariffs protect local jobs but raise prices for everyone. Saving one factory job can cost consumers millions.

climax.text: Trade wars are tax wars. Countries raise tariffs to punish each other, and citizens pay the price.

punchline.text: A tariff is a tax you blame on foreigners.

quiz.question: Who ultimately pays a tariff on imported goods?
